question_text: Was the Ticketmaster outage on Nov 20 a cyberattack?
answer_text: Ticketmaster has not given a cause, and no source we read says the outage was an attack or rules one out. Nobody has claimed responsibility. The only suggestion of one is an anonymous comment with no evidence.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A statement from Ticketmaster or Live Nation naming the cause, or a statement from CISA, the FBI or an outside investigator.
A Ticketmaster or Live Nation post-incident statement naming the cause.

question_text: Is the Nov 20 outage connected to the Nov 19 disruption?
answer_text: No source ties the two together. The same service was hit on both nights and both left fans unable to load tickets, but nobody has said whether they share a cause.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Ticketmaster saying the two events had the same cause or different causes.

question_text: Was it part of the week's other outages?
answer_text: No link has been shown. The White House said on Nov 18 that it sees no evidence the recent incidents are related. That statement came before the Ticketmaster outage and does not name Ticketmaster.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Ticketmaster, a regulator or an independent investigator tying the incidents together or ruling it out.

question_text: What happened to fans, and for how long?
answer_text: Superdome fans could not load tickets on Friday night and the show started late; service was mostly back by about 10:30 PM ET. Wallet tickets worked there. In Mexico City a concert started nearly an hour late and festival entry was hit.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: A Ticketmaster statement giving the outage's start, end and reach.

question_text: Is someone probing these companies' systems?
answer_text: An anonymous Downdetector comment says so, with no evidence. No outlet, company or official has said it.
label: Rumor
what_would_settle_it: Evidence of an attack on Ticketmaster or a statement from an official.
